notes.title: Giant Life - Release!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34868207/00071bfdf1371b6f57fd59dd9f86c132b4b5cd11.gif[/img]
Well hello guys!
Today we are releasing the version 1.0 of Giant Life, a VR physic puzzle game.
Play as an angry giant through a virtual reality journey, exploring the realm, destroying settlements and frightening its inhabitants.

[h1][b]Main features:[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] 5 special throwable projectiles.
[*] 22 unique levels.
[*] More than 50 destructible structures.
[*] Finger tracking for Valve Index, HTC Vive and Oculus rift controllers.
[*] Vikings, Knights and Pirates.
[*] Cute low poly graphics.
[/list]

[h1][b]Suggestions:[/b][/h1]
We hope you guys enjoy the game, and if you have any suggestions leave them in the suggestion section in the community hub:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1081250/discussions/2/

[h1][b]Bug reports[/b][/h1]
If you find any bugs feel free to report them in the community hub section.
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1081250/discussions/0/

[h1][b]Discord[/b][/h1]
Come gather around a Giant Life! We'll be having weekly contest and giveaways!
[url=https://discord.gg/FF6dxzC]Join us on Discord![/url]

notes.title: Update 1.10
notes.notes:
Today we are presenting the [b]1.10 version[/b] of Hex Defense.
We've polished up plenty of late game mechanics, that we think will blend easier for those who want to make high scores in each level.

[b][u]Patch notes:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Removed hints from the controllers.
[*] Modified and balanced the spawn ratios according to waves.
[*] Improved proyectile collisions.
[*] Spawners that will become active the upcoming wave are now displayed in white.
[*] Tweaked oculus controller animations.
[/list]

We hope you guys enjoy, and if you find any bugs or have any suggestions, leave them in the community hub!

[b]The Patagoniart Team.[/b]

notes.title: Update 1.07
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Update 1.07[/b][/h1]

Today we are releasing the version 1.07 of Hex Defense.
Plenty of minor adjustments and bugfixes were addressed.

Here are the patch notes:
[list]
[*] Updated the version of SteamVR to 2.2;
[*] This fixed the issue regarding the controllers being duplicated once pressing the steam menu.
[*] The local movement is now more dynamic.
[*] Corrected glitch in towers upon creation.
[*] Improved enemy AI, this will lower the late game fps drops.
[/list]

We hope you guys enjoy, and if you find any bugs or have suggestions feel free to leave them in the community hub section.

[b]The Patagoniart Team.[/b]

notes.title: Release! + Hotfix.
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Today we are presenting the version 1.0 of Hex Defense.[/b][/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34329477/5c4f336e7626c78c43d100abe326554e10099b8d.png[/img]

[b][u]Patch notes:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Optimized batching draws. The game will run 15/20 % faster depending on graphic card and HMD used.
[*] Upon level completion the player will be able to continue playing to climb the leaderboard.
[*] Spawners will show hints upon inminent activation. 
[*] Fixed bindings for the vive controllers.
[*] Changed minor graphical settings.
[*] Improved pathfinding on enemy AI. Reduced the chance of traffic jam.
[*] Fixed glitch in Player collider.
[/list]

We would love to keep adding content for the game, but for that we need YOUR feedback, so feel free to leave us your suggestions or bugs, if you find any, in the community hubs:

https://steamcommunity.com/app/1014900

[h1]We hope you have fun![/h1]

[b][u][h1]Hotfix 1.02[/h1][/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Corrected major problem on leaderboard localization.
[*] Corrected visual glitch in asteroid level causing unusable tiles.
[*] Leaderboards will be updated in real time while playing, not at the end of level anymore.
[/list]

Starting monday 18th, we'll start working on the 1.1 update. 
In the meantime, feel free to leave your suggestions, bugs and reviews.

[b]The Patagoniart Team.[/b]

notes.title: Beta 0.92
notes.notes:
[b][h1]Today we are finally releasing the Beta Stable 0.92.[/h1][/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34329477/9517ccf00638c39ca8d92b0c1d87875116513b0a.png[/img]
Yesterday the beta opt-in was closed, so if you've got picked you'll probably receive a copy of the game during the weekend.

Plenty of content was added to the game, so without further rambling here are the patch notes:
[list]
[*] Added extra informational panel to the start of the game.
[*] Interfaces will now change in real time depending on energy available.
[*] A radius display is now shown on the hex when selecting towers to purchase.
[*] Selecting a tower will display its radius, hovering on the upgrade button will show the potential radius of the upgraded tower.
[*] Major improvement to the Vive controllers precision. (We are going to revamp the Oculus next week)  
[*] Local rotation changed to the right controller. Use the Grip and Hover on the right controller to rotate. 
[*] The Holographic table height can be changed interacting with the borders.
[*] Added more information on the Level Selection panels.
[*] Corrected minor visual glitches.    
[/list]

We hope you guys enjoy, and for those who don't have the game yet, we'll update the Demo with the most recent patches during the weekend.

Enjoy!

[b]The Patagoniart Team[/b]

notes.title: Road to Release and Demo!
notes.notes:
With the [b]full release[/b] upcoming, we've been working hard in the Studio to get everything done in time.

It's been a long couple of weeks polishing up graphic details, correcting errors in AI, and last but not least we are presenting 3 new enemy units that were added to the current build instead of the first patch after release: [b]MECHS[/b].

We've decided to add a free [b]Demo[/b] for those who want to try out the basic gameplay mechanics.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34329477/2b3263713db6e85133f62518b723a7752e418cbb.gif[/img]

[b]Patch notes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Corrected glitch of AI getting stuck on corners.
[*]Added 3 enemy mechs units.
[*]Corrected UI timings.
[*]Improved collision  for enemies.
[*]Changed the texture of the Volcano.
[*]Improved lava texture in the Volcano.
[*]Ambiance fog is now added to the Swamp.
[*]Added custom sound to enemy soldiers upon death.
[/list]

We are going to keep on polishing up the final version and we hope to hear from you guys!

[b]The Patagoniart Team[/b]
